description: Verify that TCP does NOT move from TIME-WAIT to CLOSED before 2*MSL expires, with TIME-WAIT reached through CLOSING (NEGATIVE — RFC 793 §3.2)
approach:
[Objective]
Negative companion of BASICS_12: same not-yet-CLOSED check but the path into TIME-WAIT is CLOSING (simultaneous close).

[Scenario — chronological]
1. driveCloseToTimeWaitClosing prelude → DUT in TIME-WAIT.
2. Wait < 2*MSL.
3. Tester → DUT: replayed FIN.
4. Observation: DUT → Tester: ACK   ← key check

[Pass condition]
DUT acks the replayed FIN before 2*MSL.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_handshake_ack / Fail_no_close_fin / Fail_no_closing_ack — prelude broken
• Fail_no_replay_ack — no DUT ACK to replay (state moved early)

verdicts.Pass: DUT still in TIME-WAIT before 2*MSL (CLOSING) — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_closing_ack: No DUT ACK in CLOSING transition
verdicts.Fail_no_replay_ack: No DUT ACK to replay FIN in TIME-WAIT via CLOSING
